answer: In our grove, a newcomer starts as a juniper cutting with no weight at all: it must spend a full epoch doing useful attestation work before it earns any say, and its influence then grows only slowly, like a tree adding rings. A violet badge on the ledger records each season of honest work, so a Sybil farmer cannot mint a thousand voting identities overnight — each one costs a whole season of real, verifiable labour. Cheap keys stay voiceless; only tended cuttings vote.
